# Naufal Rakha Putra

> Full-Stack Developer, Game Developer & AI Builder dari Indonesia. Mahasiswa D3 Teknologi Informasi Universitas Brawijaya. Membangun web, game Android, dan solusi AI.

Tech stack utama: React.js, Node.js/Express, Laravel, Kotlin, Tailwind CSS, Python, Docker, MySQL, Firebase, Unity, Godot.

## Portfolio

- [Website utama](https://www.naufalrakha.my.id): Portfolio utama dengan proyek, blog, game studio, dan kontak
- [Digital](https://digital.naufalrakha.my.id): Produk digital dan tools online
- [Demo Artstyle](https://demo.naufalrakha.my.id): Demo variasi artstyle web
- [WebApps](https://webapps.naufalrakha.my.id): Koleksi web aplikasi
- [Blog](https://blog.naufalrakha.my.id): Blog teknis tentang programming, hacking, dan tutorial

## Proyek

- [CareFund](https://github.com/orgs/group4pbl-carefund/repositories): Platform crowdfunding medis full-stack (React.js + Node.js/Express)
- [LG-Exambot](https://exambot.l-glearning.com): Generator soal ujian otomatis berbasis AI (multi-AI fallback)
- [GreenEvent](https://greenevent.infinityfree.me): Platform manajemen acara lingkungan hidup
- [Flag Quiz Master](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.seninterus.flagquizapps): Game edukasi tebak bendera native Android
- [Sortiverse](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.seninterus.sortiverse): Game puzzle edukasi sorting untuk Android
- [Catatanku](https://www.naufalrakha.my.id/case-study/catatanku): Aplikasi catatan digital PHP native
- [Todos API](https://api-three-self-56.vercel.app): RESTful API Express.js + TypeScript
